hypotheses.reasoning: msg-223156 at offset 479309 crashes the worker with a stack overflow in expandReferences, probably from a self-referencing template. The offset is never committed, so each restart re-reads the same message and crashes again. The worker had been healthy for 12 minutes on v4.19.7 before this, and no deploy happened near the onset. The other services logged no errors.

verdict.recommendedAction: Skip or dead-letter offset 479309 (msg-223156) and restart the worker so it moves past the message. Fix expandReferences to detect cyclic references and add a depth limit. Add a catch-and-DLQ path so one bad message can't crash the process.
